aiReview.summary: Official Google developer hub for Gemini API docs, Google AI Studio, Gemma open models, on-device Edge/Nano, and related APIs including Imagen and Veo. Strong maintained documentation entry point; not a video-only SDK or model card.
evidence: canonicalUrl https://ai.google.dev is Google’s official AI for Developers site.
Meta description and body reference Gemini API, AI Studio, Gemma, Imagen, and Veo.
Rubric prefers official maintained docs over news recaps or closed demo reels.
uncertainty: Current Veo API surface, pricing, and availability were not verified beyond the hub mention.
Free-tier vs paid Gemini API terms were not fetched from billing pages.
aiReview.tagline: Official docs and APIs for Google generative models
aiReview.description: Access official API docs, AI Studio, open models, and on-device tools to build apps with Google’s generative models.
pros: Official Google developer site with Gemini API documentation and Google AI Studio.
Landing page links Gemma open models, Google AI Edge, and responsible-AI guidance.
Explicitly lists building with models including Imagen and Veo via an API key.
Includes showcases, community forum, and multilingual documentation.
cons: Hub page is marketing-heavy; API and video-generation details live on nested doc routes.
Commercial API usage, quotas, and Veo-specific limits are not specified on this landing page.
